title: BPS provincial GRDP by industry, current and constant 2010 prices, 2021-2025, Indonesia (38 provinces)

columns.province_code: BPS province code (kode_bps). Names and Kemendagri codes in 'provinces'.
columns.sector: Industry code; names in 'sectors'. TOTAL is GRDP, NONOIL is GRDP excluding oil and gas.
columns.status: BPS revision marker: * preliminary (2024), ** very preliminary (2025).
columns.value: Rp billion, rounded to whole billions as published.

sectors.A: Pertanian, Kehutanan, dan Perikanan (agriculture, forestry and fishing)
sectors.B1: Pertambangan Minyak, Gas dan Panas Bumi (crude oil, natural gas and geothermal)
sectors.B2: Pertambangan Batubara dan Lignit (coal and lignite mining)
sectors.B4: Pertambangan dan Penggalian Lainnya (other mining and quarrying)
sectors.D: Pengadaan Listrik dan Gas (electricity and gas)
sectors.E: Pengadaan Air, Pengelolaan Sampah, Limbah dan Daur Ulang (water supply and waste)
sectors.G: Perdagangan Besar dan Eceran; Reparasi Mobil dan Sepeda Motor (trade)
sectors.I: Penyediaan Akomodasi dan Makan Minum (accommodation and food)
sectors.K: Jasa Keuangan dan Asuransi (finance and insurance)
sectors.MN: Jasa Perusahaan (business services, M and N)
sectors.O: Administrasi Pemerintahan, Pertahanan dan Jaminan Sosial Wajib (public administration)
sectors.Q: Jasa Kesehatan dan Kegiatan Sosial (health and social work)
sectors.RSTU: Jasa Lainnya (other services, R to U)
sectors.NONOIL: PDRB tanpa migas (GRDP excluding oil and gas)

grdp_current.name: PDRB atas dasar harga berlaku (GRDP at current prices), Seri 2010
grdp_current.source: BPS, PDRB Provinsi-Provinsi di Indonesia Menurut Lapangan Usaha 2021-2025

grdp_constant.name: PDRB atas dasar harga konstan 2010 (GRDP at constant 2010 prices), Seri 2010
grdp_constant.source: BPS, PDRB Provinsi-Provinsi di Indonesia Menurut Lapangan Usaha 2021-2025

pdf.title: Produk Domestik Regional Bruto Provinsi-Provinsi di Indonesia Menurut Lapangan Usaha 2021-2025, Tabel 9-84

meaning.~0: less than half a unit (under Rp 0.5 billion)

notes: Source error: Tabel 77 (Papua, current prices) repeats the 2022 values in its 2023 cells for A, B (B1-B4) and C, while its other 2023 cells and its 2023 GRDP cover the post-split province. Those cells are not written (listed in 'gaps' with marker 'source error') and the industries-to-GRDP check skips Papua current 2023.
A cell marked '–' (nil) or '~0' (under Rp 0.5 billion) has no row; 'gaps' lists every such cell. Where coal mining (B2) has no row, the province has no coal mining output, or under Rp 0.5 billion.
Papua Barat Daya (92), Papua Selatan (95), Papua Tengah (96) and Papua Pegunungan (97) have values from 2023; Papua (94) and Papua Barat (91) cover the post-split areas in this publication.
Only the 17 main industries, the four mining sub-industries and the two totals are read; other sub-industries in the tables are not.
Shares and growth rates are derived in analysis/.

Compared with the provincial offices' subsector tables in data/20261108_bps-province-grdp-subsector (earlier vintages), some B, B2 and TOTAL values differ ('checks.revision_comparison'); this April 2026 national publication is the later release and is the one used.

format.missing: a missing row means the source has no value; no placeholder values are written
